metadata.scope: Phase 1-13 implementation specification documents for issue #1088 (Task B manual Google Form resync follow-up: display ingestion duration durationMs). Adds durationMs measurement to apps/api runResponseSync() (succeeded/failed/skipped 3 paths) and ResponseSyncResult, extends apps/web SyncResultSchema (.strict()) and ManualFormResyncPanel result <dl> with a durationMs row + regression tests. Single implementation cycle (CONST_007), both backend and frontend in one PR.
metadata.investigationConclusion: Codebase investigation confirmed durationMs is NOT implemented anywhere on the manual form resync path and is NOT resolved by any other task. SyncResultSchema (manual-sync.ts:3-12) lacks durationMs; resultRows() (ManualFormResyncPanel.client.tsx:34-42) has no durationMs row; ResponseSyncResult (sync-forms-responses.ts:99-107) and runResponseSync() (3 return paths) do not measure or return durationMs; responses-sync.ts (route) passes result through unchanged. durationMs timing infra exists only on other sync patterns (sync/types.ts DiffSummary, sync/audit.ts withSyncMutex, sync/manual.ts:87 hardcoded 0). Issue text remains aligned with current code; the only optimization is to pin the backend producer to the precise current implementation (sync-forms-responses.ts runResponseSync + ResponseSyncResult) rather than the vague 'sync use-case' wording. implementation_mode = new.
metadata.rootCauseOptimization: Issue named the backend producer vaguely ('apps/api POST /admin/sync/responses sync use-case'). Optimized to current code: producer = runResponseSync() in apps/api/src/jobs/sync-forms-responses.ts (ResponseSyncResult interface lines 99-107, 3 return paths at lines 154/225/268). The route apps/api/src/routes/admin/responses-sync.ts returns result verbatim so it needs no change once ResponseSyncResult carries durationMs.
